title: Blind dual variant read + discordance resolution
description: Two interpreters classify the same variant without seeing each other's call; the vote preserves ties and discordance routes to explicit resolution before sign-out.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-bio-01
  title: Blind dual variant read + discordance resolution
  description: Two interpreters classify the same variant without seeing each other's call; the vote preserves
    ties and discordance routes to explicit resolution before sign-out.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Reach a variant classification where agreement was demonstrated rather than assumed. This
    workflow structures interpretation for a qualified professional and is not a diagnostic device or
    medical advice.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: De-identified variant evidence package
      summary: De-identified variant evidence package
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - variant_records
              - population_frequencies
              - functional_evidence
              - phenotype_summary
            properties:
              variant_records: {}
              population_frequencies: {}
              functional_evidence: {}
              phenotype_summary: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-read1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: bio-01
      name: First independent classification
      summary: Independent read 1; produced without sight of the other reads.
      role: Variant scientist classifying variants against evidence criteria.
      prompt: You are a Genomic Variant Interpreter. You classify variants against explicit evidence criteria
        — population frequency, computational prediction, functional data, segregation, case observations
        — and you record the strength assigned to each line of evidence separately. You return 'uncertain
        significance' when the evidence supports only that, and you never let a clinically satisfying
        story upgrade a variant the evidence does not carry. This structures interpretation for a qualified
        professional; it is not a diagnosis.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - evidence-verification
          - decision-analysis
          - clinical-evidence-appraisal
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:variant-database
        permissions:
          - read-only
          - phi-restricted
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - classification
          - evidence_codes
          - conflicting_evidence
          - confidence
        properties:
          classification: {}
          evidence_codes: {}
          conflicting_evidence: {}
          confidence: {}
    - id: n-read2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: bio-01
      name: Second independent classification
      summary: Independent read 2; produced without sight of the other reads.
      role: Variant scientist classifying variants against evidence criteria.
      prompt: You are a Genomic Variant Interpreter. You classify variants against explicit evidence criteria
        — population frequency, computational prediction, functional data, segregation, case observations
        — and you record the strength assigned to each line of evidence separately. You return 'uncertain
        significance' when the evidence supports only that, and you never let a clinically satisfying
        story upgrade a variant the evidence does not carry. This structures interpretation for a qualified
        professional; it is not a diagnosis.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - evidence-verification
          - decision-analysis
          - clinical-evidence-appraisal
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:variant-database
        permissions:
          - read-only
          - phi-restricted
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - classification
          - evidence_codes
          - conflicting_evidence
          - confidence
        properties:
          classification: {}
          evidence_codes: {}
          conflicting_evidence: {}
          confidence: {}
    - id: n-read3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: bio-05
      name: Statistical and evidence-strength review
      summary: Independent read 3; produced without sight of the other reads.
      role: Biostatistician reviewing design, analysis, and inference in biological studies.
      prompt: You are a Biostatistics Reviewer. You check whether the analysis matches the design, whether
        multiplicity and clustering were handled, and whether the effect estimate's uncertainty is reported
        honestly. You state when a study is underpowered for the claim being made rather than reporting
        the p-value it happened to produce, and you flag analyses that were clearly chosen after the data
        were seen.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - operations-planning
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - classification
          - evidence_codes
          - conflicting_evidence
          - confidence
        properties:
          classification: {}
          evidence_codes: {}
          conflicting_evidence: {}
          confidence: {}
    - id: n-vote
      kind: aggregator
      name: Tally independent classifications
      summary: Tally classification across the independent reads and preserve ties rather than averaging
        them.
      config:
        aggregation: vote
    - id: n-concordance
      kind: condition
      name: Reads concordant?
      summary: Route on vote.tally has a single majority for classification.
      config:
        expression: vote.tally has a single majority for classification
        branches:
          - label: Concordant
            when: concordant
          - label: Discordant
            when: discordant
    - id: n-adjudicate
      kind: agent
      templateRef: bio-06
      name: Resolve the discordant classification on the record
      summary: Resolve the discordance on the record; the disagreement itself is evidence.
      role: Data steward enforcing provenance, consent, and de-identification on biological data.
      prompt: You are a Research Data Steward. You verify that every dataset carries its provenance, consent
        scope, and de-identification status, and you block a use that exceeds the consent the data were
        collected under. You treat re-identification risk from combined datasets as a real risk rather
        than a theoretical one, and you state the specific fields that create it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evidence-verification
          - domain-analysis
          - de-identification
          - teaching
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
        connectors:
          - mcp:lims
        permissions:
          - read-only
          - phi-restricted
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Qualified professional sign-out on the final classification
      summary: Pause for the qualified reviewing professional; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Blind dual variant read + discordance resolution deliverable, the
        evidence behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-bio-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-read1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-bio-01-edge-2
      from: n-intake
      to: n-read2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-bio-01-edge-3
      from: n-intake
      to: n-read3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-bio-01-edge-4
      from: n-read1
      to: n-vote
      kind: data
    - id: wf-bio-01-edge-5
      from: n-read2
      to: n-vote
      kind: data
    - id: wf-bio-01-edge-6
      from: n-read3
      to: n-vote
      kind: data
    - id: wf-bio-01-edge-7
      from: n-vote
      to: n-concordance
      kind: data
    - id: wf-bio-01-edge-8
      from: n-concordance
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: concordant
    - id: wf-bio-01-edge-9
      from: n-concordance
      to: n-adjudicate
      kind: control
      condition: discordant
    - id: wf-bio-01-edge-10
      from: n-adjudicate
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-bio-01-edge-11
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
